select
from asset_card_detail where is_deleted = false AND approve_status = 'approve'
and main_id = #{params.cardId}
AND ( code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') OR name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') ) ORDER BY case when code ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when code ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , code
